name: ayrshare
displayName: Ayrshare - Unified Social Media API for AI Agents
description: The unified social media API for AI agents. Publish, schedule, and analyze across 13+ networks from Claude Code, with post history for brand voice and content validation against each platform's rules before every post.

api_key.title: Ayrshare API key
api_key.description: Your Ayrshare API key, from app.ayrshare.com under Settings, then API Key. It is sent to the Ayrshare API on every call and is stored in your system's secure credential store.

profile_key.title: Profile-Key (optional)
profile_key.description: A client profile's Profile-Key, to make every call act as that client by default. Leave it empty to act on your primary profile. Once saved, a blank field keeps the old value; run /ayrshare:setup to remove it.

x_api_key.title: X Consumer Key (optional)
x_api_key.description: Your X app's Consumer Key (also called API Key), from the X Developer Console under OAuth 1.0 Keys. Needed for any X/Twitter call (posting, analytics, messages). Set it together with the X Consumer Secret, or leave both empty. Once saved, a blank field keeps the old value.

x_api_secret.title: X Consumer Secret (optional)
x_api_secret.description: Your X app's Consumer Secret (also called API Key Secret), shown with the Consumer Key in the X Developer Console. Needed for any X/Twitter call (posting, analytics, messages). Set it together with the X Consumer Key, or leave both empty. Once saved, a blank field keeps the old value.
